projects.title: Your Text, Your Style
projects.summary: Turns bulk text or Markdown into a PowerPoint deck in the style of any uploaded template, using the visitor's own LLM API key, which is never stored.

projects.title: LLM Agent Proof-of-Concept
projects.summary: A minimal browser-based agent that reasons in a loop and calls tools as the model decides: Google search snippets, an AI Pipe proxy and sandboxed JavaScript, streaming its output to the page.

projects.title: Data Analyst Agent
projects.summary: Takes a task in plain English with optional CSV, JSON or image attachments, then sources, analyses and visualises the data itself and returns the answer as JSON within strict time limits.

projects.title: Virtual Teaching Assistant
projects.tagline: Tools in Data Science (TDS), IIT Madras
projects.summary: Answers student questions for the TDS course from scraped course content and Discourse forum posts, returning context-aware answers with references as JSON in under 30 seconds.

projects.title: Placement Portal Application (PPA)
projects.summary: Lets admins, companies and students run campus recruitment: placement drives, applications, eligibility filtering, automated reminders, monthly reports and CSV export.

projects.title: ParkEase
projects.summary: Role-based parking platform: admins manage lots, spots and users, and customers book and vacate spots in real time, with Redis caching and Celery jobs for reminders and monthly reports.

projects.title: Quiz Master V1
projects.summary: Admins manage subjects, chapters and quizzes; students take timed quizzes with a live countdown and auto-submit, then track their results.

projects.title: Cinema Audience Forecasting Challenge
projects.summary: Forecasts daily audience counts across theatres from online and point-of-sale booking data, theatre metadata and calendar effects such as weekends and holidays.

projects.title: Hotel Booking Cancellation Prediction
projects.summary: Predicts whether a hotel booking will be cancelled from customer, booking and stay features such as lead time, room type and booking history.

projects.title: House Price Prediction
projects.summary: Predicts house prices from mixed categorical and numerical data for a Kaggle competition, scored on R².

projects.title: Movie Review Sentiment Prediction
projects.summary: Classifies movie reviews as negative, neutral or positive from review phrases combined with structured features.

projects.title: Messy Mashup
projects.summary: Classifies music genres from noisy mashups of instrument stems taken from different songs, handling tempo changes, cross-song mixing and background noise. Evaluated on Macro F1.

projects.title: Portcast Data Analyst Intern
projects.summary: Traced a container's 7-day delay to a missed connection at Singapore, estimated what inaccurate ETAs cost a manufacturer each year, and reviewed an AI-written plan to integrate 50+ tracking feeds.

projects.title: Competitive Strategy and Financial Optimization for Clothing Business
projects.summary: Analysed a readymade garments shop's costs, revenue and market position from primary data, and proposed pricing, inventory and customer-retention strategies to improve working capital and profit.
